items.title: Game Week - Chattanooga
No. 3/7/7 Alabama Takes Down Vanderbilt, 21-6
items.summary: NASHVILLE, Tenn. - No. 3/7/7 Alabama football (8-2, 6-2 SEC) claimed victory in its final road game of the regular season, taking down Vanderbilt 4-6 (1-6 SEC), 21-6, inside FirstBank Stadium. The Crimson Tide held the Commodores out of the end zone for the entire game, sealing the win with a 21-point barrage in a 7:53 span across the second and third quarters.
